season.source: Cleared: the derived 'not year-round' rested on our note's 'closed during hunting season', which the Forest Service page contradicts ('Used as a hunt camp during general gun season. Camping is allowed to non-hunters during general gun season.'); the page gives no season. https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/porter-lake, read 2026-10-21

note: USFS primitive camping and day-use area on Porter Lake in the Ochlockonee River floodplain, a trailhead on the Florida National Scenic Trail with paddle access into the floodplain channels; a few sites with fire pits. Accessible by maintained dirt road (E) / paved road (W); a reviewer fit a 23-ft Class C. Serves as a hunt camp during general gun season (camping still open to non-hunters). --Claude
